source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with a rocky pine-shaded retreat, open pavilion with scholar figures, bamboo and gnarled trees on the right, a small bridge over a curving stream, distant bird flocks, and extensive ink linework with pale blue-gray washes. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: monumental_left_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the large old pine dominating the left side: thick twisting trunk, exposed knots, branching limbs, and dense rounded clusters of pine needles extending across the upper-left and middle of the scene. Exclude the pavilion roof, rocks, and nearby shrubs except where pine trunk or needles are visibly part of the tree.
must_preserve: gnarled bark contours and knotted trunk texture
dark ink outlines around twisting branches
radiating pine-needle clusters with blue-gray wash accents
irregular branch rhythm and overhanging horizontal limb

motifs.name: open_hillside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small open pavilion set into the hillside beneath the pine, including its sloped tiled roof, open posts, lattice walls, porch, seated scholar and attendant-like interior figures, and the immediate architectural platform. Exclude surrounding large pine trunk, rocks, and distant shrubs unless structurally attached to the pavilion.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and layered eaves
parallel roof tile lines
thin post-and-lattice linework
small interior scholar figures and red color accents
delicate ink outlines of platform and steps

motifs.name: left_rocky_bank_with_grasses
motifs.description: Isolate the rugged left foreground bank and cliff base with rounded rocks, cave-like hollows, tufts of grass, and wash-textured slopes beneath the pine. Avoid including the pavilion architecture and the pine crown; retain only rocks, ground, and low vegetation.
must_preserve: soft gray ink wash in rock masses
dark crevice outlines and hollow openings
short grass strokes and stippled ground texture
rounded boulder contours at the lower-left edge
transition from steep rock face to sloped earth

motifs.name: central_cliff_outcrop_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the middle rocky ledge behind and to the right of the pavilion, with pale gray boulders, broken cliff planes, scattered shrubs, and small blue-green foliage washes. Exclude the pavilion roof and the large pine branches above.
must_preserve: layered rock contours and pale ink washes
small shrub clusters with dotted foliage
blue-green wash accents in bushes
irregular cliff edge beneath the pavilion area
fine texture strokes on the sloping ground

motifs.name: right_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall bamboo grove on the right side, including multiple segmented bamboo stalks, narrow leaves, drooping leafy sprays, and darker clustered foliage near the upper stems. Exclude the adjacent gnarled broadleaf tree as much as possible.
must_preserve: vertical segmented bamboo culms with dark nodes
fine tapering bamboo leaves
overlapping pale and dark ink leaf clusters
leaning rhythm of the bamboo stalks
blue-gray wash shadows around foliage

motifs.name: right_gnarled_broadleaf_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the twisting broadleaf tree on the right foreground slope, with heavy dark curving trunk, branching limbs, dense rounded leaf clusters, and exposed roots merging into the hillside. Avoid the bamboo stalks behind it and the bridge below.
must_preserve: dark sinuous trunk and branch linework
dense small leaf clusters drawn as rounded ink marks
pale wash modeling on bark and roots
interlaced branch structure crossing the open space
root forms gripping the sloped bank

motifs.name: bridge_with_standing_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small wooden bridge in the lower center, including railings, posts, plank deck, underside supports, and the single standing scholar figure on the bridge. Exclude the stream except for minimal contact edges directly under the bridge.
must_preserve: thin railing and post geometry
parallel plank lines across the bridge deck
vertical support posts beneath the bridge
tiny standing scholar silhouette and robe lines
delicate ink accents defining the bridge edges

motifs.name: curving_stream_and_banks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale winding stream flowing from beneath the bridge toward the bottom foreground, including curved current lines, narrow banks, adjacent rocks, and wash-textured embankments. Exclude the bridge structure and seals at the far lower margins.
must_preserve: long parallel curving water lines
soft blank-paper water reserve
dark bank edges and small rock accents
gray wash on enclosing slopes
flow direction bending from bridge to lower foreground

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
